home.title: David Arroyo
home.description:
With over 10 years of experience in web development, designing, building and delivering intuitive and scalable solutions for complex products and services. Strong expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript and Node.js, with hands-on experience in other programming languages such as Python, and the ability to adapt quickly to new stacks. Solid background in frontend and backend development, API design, and the implementation of clean, maintainable architectures.

Experience in cross-functional collaboration, mentoring, code review, and team growth support. Detail-oriented engineer focused on continuous improvement, learning, and upholding high-quality engineering standards.
